description: Machine-readable readiness score models for SaaS conversion, MCP and AI tooling, and personal AI maturity, aligned with qa-agent/saas-readiness-council.md and qa-agent/personal-ai-memory-and-tools.md.

scoreModels.name: SaaS readiness
scoreModels.description: Scores how close AiXia is to multi-tenant SaaS operations with isolation, onboarding, billing, configuration, analytics, support, and AI usage governance.

scores.label: Internal company only
requiredCapabilities: Single-company mental model acceptable for internal pilot usage only
blockers: No meaningful tenant isolation story for external companies
No SaaS onboarding or entitlement model

scores.label: Basic tenant identifier
scores.definition: Basic company_id exists but tenant separation is incomplete.
requiredCapabilities: Company or tenant identifier present in core tables or queries
blockers: RLS, storage, or UI paths still risk cross-tenant reads or writes
No standardized tenant configuration surface

scores.label: Tenant-separated data
scores.definition: Tenant-separated data exists but onboarding and configuration are weak.
requiredCapabilities: Data paths consistently scoped by tenant for primary modules
blockers: No guided onboarding or weak default tenant setup
Limited self-service admin configuration

scores.label: Tenant-ready
scores.definition: Tenant-ready with roles and settings but no billing or plan controls.
requiredCapabilities: Role model and tenant-level settings sufficient for multiple companies in pilot
Support for feature flags or module toggles at tenant scope where applicable
blockers: No subscription, seat, or usage-based billing controls
No formal plan entitlements enforcement across modules

scores.label: SaaS-ready core
scores.definition: SaaS-ready with onboarding, tenant settings, plan controls, and analytics.
requiredCapabilities: Guided onboarding and workspace setup for new tenants
Plan and entitlement enforcement for paid or limited modules
Product analytics for activation and retention signals
blockers: Customer success tooling still shallow
Limited AI usage metering or governance tied to plans

scores.label: Full SaaS-grade
scores.definition: Full SaaS-grade tenant isolation, billing, onboarding, analytics, support, AI usage controls, and audit logs.
requiredCapabilities: Strong tenant isolation across database, storage, AI tools, and MCP
Operational billing and downgrade or upgrade paths with clear entitlements
In-product guidance, health metrics, and support workflows
AI usage limits and audit trails aligned to plans and security policy

scoreModels.name: MCP readiness
scoreModels.description: Scores how safely AiXia functions could be exposed as MCP tools with permissions, confirmation, audit, and recovery posture.

scores.label: Not ready for AI access
scores.definition: Not ready for AI access through MCP or similar automation.
requiredCapabilities: Human-only interaction is the only supported mode
blockers: No tool contract, no permission mapping, no audit story

scores.label: Explain page only
scores.definition: AI can explain the page only.
requiredCapabilities: Stable route metadata and safe public help text for explanation
blockers: No safe read APIs for domain objects through tools
No structured error handling for model calls

scores.label: Search and read records
scores.definition: AI can search and read records within strict permission boundaries.
requiredCapabilities: Record-level authorization checks mirrored from the app
Tenant scoping enforced for every query path
blockers: No logging of read access for sensitive domains
Ambiguous filters that could leak neighboring rows

scores.label: Prepare drafts
scores.definition: AI can prepare drafts of records or documents under preview rules.
requiredCapabilities: Draft lifecycle distinct from official submit
Field-level validation parity with manual forms
blockers: Drafts can be mistaken for committed records
No preview or diff step before commit

scores.label: Execute safe actions with confirmation
scores.definition: AI can execute safe actions with explicit confirmation and audit.
requiredCapabilities: High-friction confirmation for mutating tools
Structured audit records for each tool invocation
blockers: Missing rollback or compensating actions for partial failures
Incomplete permission checks on tool arguments

scores.label: Fully MCP-ready
scores.definition: Fully MCP-ready with permissions, audit logs, and rollback or fallback paths.
requiredCapabilities: Comprehensive allowlist of tools with documented risk class
End-to-end observability for tool failures and retries
Documented rollback or safe fallback behavior for multi-step workflows

scoreModels.name: Personal AI maturity
scoreModels.description: Scores end-user personal assistant capability from explain-only through safe execution with confirmation, audit, memory, and user controls.

scores.label: No AI support
scores.definition: No AI support for the reviewed surface.
requiredCapabilities: Baseline product works without assistant features
blockers: No assistant entry point
No safe integration hooks

scores.label: Explain
scores.definition: AI can explain allowed UI within the session context.
requiredCapabilities: Basic assistant shell with safe static explanations
blockers: No navigation or data-backed answers yet

scores.label: Guide and navigate
scores.definition: AI can guide and navigate within permitted routes.
requiredCapabilities: Route graph or feature map aligned to permissions
blockers: No read access to registries for grounded answers

scores.label: Read and search allowed data
scores.definition: AI can read and search allowed data for the active user and tenant.
requiredCapabilities: Search APIs that respect RLS and role rules
Redaction rules for sensitive fields
blockers: No logging or policy for sensitive HR or finance reads

scores.label: Create drafts and assets
scores.definition: AI can create drafts, documents, images, or PDFs from allowed data.
requiredCapabilities: Preview flows for official outputs
Branding and template hooks where required
blockers: No controls for memory retention of generated artifacts
No clear separation between draft and official documents

scores.label: Execute workflows with governance
scores.definition: AI can execute allowed workflows with confirmation, audit, memory, and user controls.
requiredCapabilities: Per-user memory controls including view, delete, disable, export, and reset
Confirmation and cancel paths for voice and non-voice execution
Audit trail tying actions to user, tenant, tool, and outcome
